meaning:
λείπω
[in LXX: Job.4:11, Pro.19:4 (פָּרַד), al. ;]
1. trans., to leave, leave behind; pass., to be left behind, to lack before prep. (as more usual in cl.), ἐν, Jas.1:4; with genitive of thing(s), Jas.1:5 2:15.
2. Intrans., to be gone, to be wanting: with dative of person(s), Luk.18:22, Tit.3:13; τὰ λείποντα, Tit.1:5
(cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, ἐν-κατα-, περι-, ὑπο-λείπω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in…
I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you,
Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
